name: alchemy-apple-blue
label: Alchemy Stars 蓝色功能图标
preamble: A cohesive Alchemy Stars desktop animation-editor spot icon family, matching its Apple-inspired white/parchment interface and Action Blue controls. Refined flat geometric outline drawings, blue monoline, softly rounded ends, generous open negative space. These are medium-size feature illustrations, not illustrations of the Apple logo. No gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no glossy material, no chunky dark fills.

construction.grid: 48-unit grid, 34-unit live area, consistent optical mass and equal padding
construction.stroke: uniform 2-unit Action Blue outline, round caps and joins
construction.detail_budget: one recognizable core metaphor and at most 3 secondary details per icon
construction.fill_rule: open outlines; occasional tiny white inset, never large solid fills
construction.color_rule: Action Blue #0066cc outlines; white #ffffff only as small optional inset; no other icon colors
construction.shared_parts: same rounded panel, same arrow, same keyframe diamond and same joint node throughout
construction.perspective: flat frontal schematic, no isometric projection
construction.motif: small keyframe diamond integrated where it helps describe animation, never a detached decorative sparkle
construction.weight_hierarchy: blue linework defines every silhouette, any white inset is subordinate

fits: 48-128px feature, category and empty-state icons; retain vector glyphs for dense toolbars
